build.description: Emit the app to ./build with tsc (emit only; `typecheck` is the type gate). Not `nest build`/`nest start`: their SWC builder cannot rewrite `.ts` import specifiers to `.js`, so the ESM this package emits would not resolve at runtime (OT plan 31454927 task 2). Mirrors applications/openthrottle-server.

dev.description: Run the app in watch mode: tsc emits, `node --watch` reruns. Not `nest build`/`nest start`: their SWC builder cannot rewrite `.ts` import specifiers to `.js`, so the ESM this package emits would not resolve at runtime (OT plan 31454927 task 2). Mirrors applications/openthrottle-server.

start.description: Run the built app. Not `nest build`/`nest start`: their SWC builder cannot rewrite `.ts` import specifiers to `.js`, so the ESM this package emits would not resolve at runtime (OT plan 31454927 task 2). Mirrors applications/openthrottle-server.
